tier.description: The two tiers use genuinely different models; the cost diverges.

cause.description: Cause CLASSIFIED by the engine. It, not the terminal status, decides whether `terminationAnalysis` is required. Optional so as not to break an older engine during a rolling deploy.

observacao.example: The agent reopened the same task three times.

hipotese.example: The instructions don't say when the task is done.

confiancaPercent.description: Self-reported by the model, not measured.

evidenceEventIds.description: At least one, and each one has to EXIST in this session. Made-up evidence is rejected with 400 — that is what separates a hypothesis from an opinion.

terminationAnalysis.description: REQUIRED when `cause` indicates an abnormal termination.

causa.description: The ORIGIN of the failure. Never deduced by elimination — lesson from ADR 0020.

analise.example: The agent stopped responding after a 90s tool call.
